'''Minntooine''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] located in the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]]. It was one of several [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Minntooine hosted a population of Quarren who had been [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] from Dac and allied itself with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. At [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps shipyards|shipyards]] maintained on Minntooine, the [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps/Legends|Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]] subsequently constructed [[Warship/Legends|warships]] for the Confederacy.

==Description==
A remote [[Waterworld/Legends|aquatic world]],<ref name="CSWE PatriotFist" /> Minntooine was located in the [[Minntooine system/Legends|Minntooine system]], a part of the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was connected via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Eridicon system/Legends|Eridicon]] and [[Poseidenna system/Legends|Poseidenna systems]]. In addition, the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route known as the [[Minntooine Spur]] linked the [[Planet/Legends|world]] to the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]] and the [[Giblim Route]] connected it to the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony's]] [[Dellalt system/Legends|Dellalt system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
After members of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] several worlds in what would eventually become known as Mon Calamari Space between [[4400 BBY]] and [[4200 BBY]], another of Dac's [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species, the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]], feared being left behind in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] colonization. In response, the latter also settled several planets, including the uninhabited Minntooine.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:RecusantClassLightDestroyer-FF.png|thumb|left|300px|During the Clone Wars, warships such as ''Recusant''-class light destroyers were constructed at shipyards on Minntooine.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Quarren worlds of the Calamari [[Sector/Legends|sector]],<ref name="TEA" /> including Minntooine,<ref name="CSWE Minntooine" /> followed the lead of Dac's [[Quarren Isolation League/Legends|Quarren Isolation League]] and joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> Minntooine came to be governed by a Separatist junta,<ref name="CSWE PatriotFist" /> and a large segment of the world's population consisted of radical Quarren who had been [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] from Dac.<ref name="CSWE Minntooine" />

Minntooine became the site of the [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps shipyards|shipyards]] used by the<ref name="SoR" /> Quarren-dominated<ref name="TEA" /> [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps/Legends|Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]]. There, Quarren [[starshipwright]]s constructed [[Warship/Legends|warships]] for the Separatist war effort, leading to Minntooine being an important world for the species.<ref name="SoR" /> The [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]]<ref name="CC">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref> [[Patriot Fist/Legends|''Patriot Fist'']], built at some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Clone Wars' [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], was<ref name="CSWE PatriotFist" /> one of the [[Starship/Legends|ships]]<ref name="SoR" /> that Minntooine's Quarren radicals aided the world's government in constructing.<ref name="CSWE PatriotFist" />

==Behind the scenes==
Minntooine was first mentioned in [[Curtis Saxton]]'s [[2005]] reference book, ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''.<ref name="RotSCross">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square T-6.<ref name="TEA" />
